_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): drag-and-drop upload zone with validation + per-file status. Pairs with the backend feature-upload template. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-dropzone
description: Drag-and-drop upload zone: click-to-browse, size/type validation, per-file status. Pairs with feature-upload backend.
notes: Usage: <Dropzone onUpload={async (files) => { const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('file', files[0]); await api('/upload', {method:'POST', body: fd}); }} accept='.jpg,.png' maxSizeMB={5} />. TODO: adapt the endpoint to feature-upload's route and multipart field name.
